explanation: Both give a sound What/Why/How explanation of the squeeze, use a live R_75 chart, avoid web search, and report band width, ATR and RSI accurately from their own data. B is more honest that one snapshot can't confirm a squeeze. However, it says a One-Touch suits a squeeze because it isn't tied to a direction, which is inaccurate: a single One-Touch barrier is directional. A ran the full indicator set and gives more concrete, correct contract guidance (duration multiples, a Touch barrier about 1 ATR beyond the breakout).
